title: End Rod Full Block Hitbox
description: Makes end rods have a full-block, walkable hitbox
body:
This mod changes the collision shape of the End Rod block in Minecraft so 
that it behaves like a full, solid block instead of its default thin rod 
shape. This means players and other entities can walk on top of an end rod 
normally, just like standing on any other solid block, while the block 
still looks exactly like a regular end rod visually. No other behavior of 
the end rod (light emission, redstone interaction, etc.) is changed.
